newsitem.title: USA: Pennzoil, Conoco in joint products venture.
newsitem.headline: Pennzoil, Conoco in joint products venture.

text.p: Pennzoil Products Co. and Conoco Inc., a unit of DuPont Co., said Wednesday they have formed a joint venture that will combine portions of their speciality petroleum products businesses.
The 50/50 venture, called Penreco, will have estimated annual sales of about $200 million worldwide, the companies said in a statement.
Pennzoil Products, a unit of Pennzoil Co., will contribute its Penreco and Magie Bros. divisions to the venture, while Conoco will contribute its Conosol and LVT solvent businesses.

The Pennzoil divisions manufacture and market highly refined products such as white oils, petrolatums and speciality solvents, which are used in cosmetics, pharmaceuticals, plastics, textiles, agricultural products, food-processing, inks and aluminum-rolling oils.
The solvents produced by the Conoco units are used primarily in drilling fluids, and mining and cleaning products and as carrier oils for consumer products.
Pennzoil's stock rose 12.5 cents to $76.25, while DuPont edged up $1.50 to $63.125, both on the New York Stock Exchange.
